claims.label: partially_supported
claims.claim_summary: Unused details recede naturally without explicit importance scores or decay rules.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: Experience that remains unused continues to recede in detail through recursive consolidation, without separately assigned importance scores or time-based forgetting rules.

evidence_spans.source_text: These thresholds control when context is consolidated, rather than assigning importance or decay scores to individual memories.
Meanwhile, details of a routine placement episode recede through recursive consolidation (Fig. 7).
Most items without detected use remain unchanged (95.8%), so these adjacent-consolidation statistics do not establish general fading of unused knowledge.

claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: Use and disuse dynamics unify memory recall with continuous learning and capability expansion.
claims.claim_text_verbatim: This natural dynamic of use and disuse unifies the recovery of past experience with learning that deepens what the agent knows, refines how it acts, and expands what it can accomplish.

evidence_spans.source_text: On LoCoMo, Hippocam achieves 77.6% overall accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline, A-Mem, by 10.1 pp
On DDXPlus, Hippocam continues to improve after early fluctuations and maintains its lead, while Letta and A-Mem also improve.
Supplementation occurs in 28.4% of matched-call transitions and 11.7% of differing-call transitions, compared with 0.9% of transitions without detected use.
